activityDashboard.description: Track daily, weekly, and monthly active users, plus sessions and messages over time. Group by client to see platform-specific usage.

tooltips.avgDau: Daily Active Users — average number of unique users per day in the selected period.
tooltips.avgWau: Weekly Active Users — average number of unique users per rolling 7-day window.
tooltips.avgMau: Monthly Active Users — average number of unique users per rolling 30-day window.
tooltips.totalSessions: Total Droid sessions created in the selected period. Each session is a single conversation with Droid.
tooltips.totalMessages: Total messages sent across all sessions, including user, assistant, tool, and system messages.

agentEffectiveness.description: Understand the velocity of your software factory.
agentEffectiveness.descriptionHideFsc: Track engineering output across your organization. Delivery cycle time and scope per unit of work, then merged pull requests and completed issues and projects/epics from Linear or Jira over time, filterable by user. Scoped to members with an Engineering, Product, or Design work role; members without a recorded work role are excluded. Data is updated daily and displayed in UTC.
agentEffectiveness.mergedPrsMarkersCaption: Marker shows when the organization onboarded to Factory.

analyticsOverview.billableCreditsTooltip: Billable credits are the total credits charged to your organization in the selected period.
analyticsOverview.toolCallsTooltip: Autonomy ratio is the ratio of tool calls to user turns — higher means Droid does more work per interaction.
analyticsOverview.activityTooltip: DAU is the average number of unique users per day. Sessions are individual Droid conversations created in the period.
analyticsOverview.productivityTooltip: File changes include files created and edited by Droid. Commits and PRs are those created during Droid sessions.
analyticsOverview.usersTooltip: Total unique users who had at least one Droid session in the selected period.
analyticsOverview.orgDefaultUpdated: Default analytics view updated for your organization
analyticsOverview.snapshotBillingPeriod: Here's a snapshot of your current billing period (since {{since}}) across your organization.
analyticsOverview.snapshotLast30Days: Here's a snapshot of the last 30 days across your organization.
analyticsOverview.currentBillingPeriodTooltip: Shows metrics for your current billing period instead of the last 30 days.

bugAttribution.description: Which merged PRs induced production bugs, attributed by the bug attribution engine's evidence ladder (reverts, SZZ blame, LLM arbitration). High confidence means at or above {{threshold}}; below that an attribution is a lead, not a label.
bugAttribution.attributedBugsTooltip: Bugs the engine linked to at least one inducing PR.
bugAttribution.attributionRateTooltip: Share of all harvested bugs that received an attribution.
bugAttribution.highConfidenceTooltip: Attributions at or above the {{threshold}} confidence threshold.
bugAttribution.revertFreeRateTooltip: Share of merged PRs never implicated by a high-confidence attribution.
bugAttribution.noAttributionsInRange: No attributions in the selected date range.

effectivenessPage.unlabeledMembers: {{unlabeled}} of {{total}} members have no recorded work role, so their work is excluded from every number below. Work roles are collected at signup; select the Unknown work role to include them.
effectivenessPage.attributionDescription: A single inventory of your organization's SCMs.
effectivenessPage.outputDescription: Examine the yield of your software factory.
effectivenessPage.noEpdMembers: No members have an Engineering, Product, or Design work role yet. Work roles are collected at signup; members without one are not shown here.
effectivenessPage.emptyAttributedScope: No session in this date range is linked to an issue, epic or project, so scoping to attributed work leaves nothing to report. Widen the date range, or turn off Attributed work only to see all work.

attributionCoverage.noneLinkedNote: No session in this range references an issue, epic or project, so this filter has nothing to select. Attribution comes from work items linked to a session.
attributionCoverage.sessionsNote: {{attributed}} of {{total}} sessions in this range are linked to tracked work.
attributionCoverage.creditsNote: Sessions linked to tracked work account for {{share}}% of credits in this range.

myAnalyticsDashboard.snapshot: Here's a snapshot of your personal Droid usage.
myAnalyticsDashboard.startSessionHint: Start a Droid session to see your personal analytics here.

tooltips.billableCredits: Total billable credits consumed across all your Droid sessions in the selected period.
tooltips.sessions: Total Droid sessions you started in the selected period.
tooltips.messages: Total messages across your sessions, including both your messages and Droid responses.
tooltips.activeDays: Number of days you had at least one Droid session in the selected period.
tooltips.filesChanged: Total files created and edited by Droid in your sessions.
tooltips.gitCommits: Number of git commits created by Droid during your sessions.
tooltips.pullRequests: Number of pull requests created by Droid during your sessions.
tooltips.primaryModel: The model that consumed the most Factory Standard Credits in the selected period.
tooltips.userMessages: Total messages you sent to Droid in the selected period.
tooltips.toolCalls: Total tool invocations (Read, Edit, Execute, Grep, etc.) across your sessions.
tooltips.skills: Number of times Droid skills were invoked in your sessions.
tooltips.slashCommands: Number of slash commands you used in sessions.
tooltips.hooks: Number of times hooks were triggered in your sessions.
tooltips.mcpCalls: Number of MCP server calls made during your sessions.
tooltips.delegationLevel: Your overall delegation style based on autonomy ratio patterns.
tooltips.toolCallsPerSession: Average number of tool invocations per session.
tooltips.userTurnsPerSession: Average number of your messages per session. Fewer turns with more tool calls indicates higher autonomy.
tooltips.toolsAutomation: Breakdown of tool invocations, skills, slash commands, hooks, and MCP server usage across your sessions.
tooltips.delegation: The autonomy ratio measures how much work Droid does per interaction -- the ratio of tool calls to user turns. Higher means more trust and delegation.
tooltips.certifications: Earn Factory Academy certification badges by passing every quiz inside a tier. Locked badges show how many modules you have left to pass.

productivityDashboard.description: Measure code output: files created and edited, git commits, pull requests, and language breakdown.

tooltips.filesCreated: Number of new files created by Droid across all sessions.
tooltips.filesEdited: Number of existing files modified by Droid across all sessions.
tooltips.gitCommits: Number of git commits created by Droid during sessions.
tooltips.pullRequests: Number of pull requests created by Droid during sessions.

routerSavingsDashboard.description: How much Auto (the model router) saves your org, measured against observed billing rates: the same routed usage priced at your org's own non-Auto usage rate, or at the frontier-model rate. All figures are managed billing only; BYOK traffic is excluded.
routerSavingsDashboard.noRoutedUsage: No routed usage in the selected period.
routerSavingsDashboard.baselineOrgUsage: Baseline: your org's measured non-Auto rate

tooltips.routedSessions: Sessions with at least one billed Auto (router) message in the selected period.
tooltips.routedFsc: Factory Standard Credits actually billed for routed messages.
tooltips.savedFscVsAllFrontier: Counterfactual minus actual: the same routed usage priced against the All-Frontier baseline, minus what was actually billed.
tooltips.savedFscVsOrgUsage: Counterfactual minus actual: routed raw tokens priced at your org's measured non-Auto billing rate, minus what was actually billed.
tooltips.savedPct: Savings are a counterfactual: the same usage priced at the baseline rate, never a promise of what you would have paid. The vs Org Usage baseline can be negative when manual traffic already runs on low-cost models.
tooltips.routerSessionAdoption: Share of billed sessions that contain at least one billed routed message.
tooltips.routedFscShare: Share of all billed FSC that was billed on routed messages.
tooltips.byokRoutedMessages: Routed messages billed on the BYOK meter (router BYOK substitution). Excluded from FSC savings because BYOK fees are not FSC-comparable.

toolsDashboard.description: Track tool calls, autonomy ratios, and usage of skills, slash commands, hooks, and MCP servers.

tooltips.delegation: The autonomy ratio measures how much work Droid does per user interaction — a higher ratio means more trust and delegation. It's the ratio of tool calls to user turns across sessions.
tooltips.p50Ratio: Median autonomy ratio across sessions — the ratio of tool calls to user turns. Higher means more delegation.
tooltips.p90Ratio: 90th percentile autonomy ratio — the ratio for the most autonomous sessions.
tooltips.toolCallsPerSession: Average number of tool invocations (Read, Edit, Execute, etc.) per session.
tooltips.userTurnsPerSession: Average number of user messages per session. Fewer turns with more tool calls indicates higher autonomy.
tooltips.toolCalls: Total invocations of built-in tools (Read, Edit, Execute, Grep, etc.) across all sessions.
tooltips.skills: Number of times Droid skills were invoked. Skills are reusable, domain-specific capabilities.
tooltips.slashCommands: Number of slash commands (e.g. /compact, /model) used by users in sessions.
tooltips.hooks: Number of times hooks were triggered. Hooks run automatically on events like session start or pre-commit.
tooltips.usersWithMcp: Number of users who have at least one MCP (Model Context Protocol) server configured.

toolsDashboard.noData: No tools data available for the selected date range.

usersDashboard.description: Explore per-user metrics and drill down into individual activity across the selected date range. Click any user to see daily details. Recent activity may take a few minutes to appear in the table below.
usersDashboard.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email, or user ID
usersDashboard.noUserData: No user data available for the selected date range.
usersDashboard.certificationsTooltip: Factory Academy certifications earned by passing module quizzes. Essentials (100-level), Advanced (200-level), Masters (300-level).

tooltips.storyPoints: Estimate points on completed issues and stories. Jira epic points are excluded.
